    scores_rounds = case['round_scores']
    targets = case['round_targets']
    forced = case['forced']
    history = []
    all_selected = set()

        indexed.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
        selected = [idx for idx, _ in indexed[:k]]
        for f in forced:
            if f not in selected:
                min_idx = min(selected, key=lambda i: scores[i])
                selected.remove(min_idx)
                selected.append(f)
        selected.sort(key=lambda i: scores[i], reverse=True)
        history.append(selected)
        all_selected.update(selected)
    retained_indices = sorted(all_selected)
    return {'history': history, 'retained_indices': retained_indices}"
}
